thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — draft GA handoff checklist needed: SLA enforcement, docs, support routing, monitoring retention, pricing edge-cases. Call out owners/gaps.

Devon Chu: I'll own SLA playbook. Do we use automatic fallback enforcement or alert-only? Need clarity.

Ravi Kapoor: Billing ops: main gaps are fallback billing rules, streaming token rounding, and auto-credit triggers if we miss p99.

Jen Torres: Monitoring: infra wants 90d traces, product wants 30d aggregates. Can we split retention by persona?

Priya (Legal): Two legal musts: (1) SLA remedies in contract must map to Console metrics; (2) opt-in limited retention checkbox for GDPR. Can't sign GA language until mapped.

Devon Chu: Proposed hosted SLOs: p50 <100ms, p95 <250ms, p99 <600ms. Fallback policy should aim to preserve p95. I'll include metric->contract map.

Maya Patel: Fallback policy: same-family lower-capacity -> regional fallback -> queued degrade with customer-visible header. Document and runbook required.

Ravi Kapoor: Billing proposal: bill for model actually served; streaming rounding per 100-token chunk; on fallback bill at lower rate and emit billing event for customer reports. Need finance signoff.

Jen Torres: Retention compromise: infra keeps 90d raw traces; product gets 30d aggregated metrics; add redaction rules for sensitive fields.

Priya (Legal): Redaction OK. For limited-retention opt-in we need UI consent flow + DPA flag. Add to GA checklist.

Deploy Bot: Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h holds. Auto-rollback if error-rate >1.5x baseline.

Maya Patel: Add runbook snippets for auto/manual rollback and customer comms templates for degraded mode.

Devon Chu: Runbook snippet I'll add to PR: ```
# Auto-rollback trigger
if error_rate > baseline * 1.5 for 15m -> rollback and page oncall
```

Ravi Kapoor: For credits: propose automated credit line applied to next invoice for contracted customers; manual CS only if opt-out. Need audit trail for finance/legal.

Priya (Legal): Contracts must allow automated credits; finance to confirm thresholds. Include audit trail requirement.

Jen Torres: Monitoring alert plan: infra gets raw alerts (90d); product sees aggregated signals (30d). Add a quality-monitor that runs prompt-suite tests and alerts regressions.

Maya Patel: Action items: Devon — SLA + runbook + metric-contract map; Jen — retention + quality-monitor spec; Ravi — billing fallback + credit automation spec; Priya — contract flag + DPA wording; Ops/DevEx — customer degraded-mode templates + support routing. PRs due EOD Wed.

Devon Chu: Opening /docs/ga-handoff PR with SLA table + runbook today.

Ravi Kapoor: Drafting billing flow and finance stub.

Jen Torres: Pushing monitoring spec and retention toggle into repo.

Priya (Legal): Circulating contract + DPA patch for review.

Maya Patel: Final ask: add an "observability cost" line in pricing docs so customers can see retention tradeoffs. We'll review PRs in Thursday triage. :thumbsup:
